pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0127 native 2D physics runtime
pr_body:
## Summary

- add typed project 2D settings and stable sorting-layer identity
- add a dedicated deterministic 2D physics world with bodies, colliders, queries, contacts, one-way platforms, controller primitives, and structured planar diagnostics
- bridge authored Collider2D/RigidBody2D/CharacterController2D into the shared Editor Play and packaged Player runtime

## Validation

Run permanent Windows Validation with the repository impact planner.
